constants.storedScoreRule: cents = floor((2N + D) / (2D)) with D = n + 1, N = 100*(hi*D - (hi - lo)*(index + 1)); capped at hi*100 - 1 for FINE and DISLIKED; storedScore = cents / 100
constants.nameOrder: Unicode code point, not UTF-16 code unit (SQL collate "C" on UTF-8), then bevId the same way
constants.streakDayKey: calendar date of the ranking instant in the profile timezone: (created_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date; week = ISO week of that date (YYYY-Www)
constants.rankOrder: points desc, bevsRanked desc, createdAt asc, userId asc; rank = 1 + count(points > mine); bevsRanked = 0 excluded
constants.treeDepth: Wu-Palmer depth from an implicit root (depth 0) above the top-level categories; a top-level category (parent null or not in the taxonomy) has depth 1
constants.embeddingRule: min(1, max(0, dot / sqrt(|a|^2 * |b|^2))); 0 when either vector is zero
constants.edgeWeightRule: tree*0.25 + content*0.15 + emb*0.30 + profile*0.30 + cop*0, summed in that order, clamped to [0, 1]
constants.edgeOrder: w desc, then bevId asc (code unit); keep w >= edgeMinWeight; at most edgeTopK
constants.pearsonRule: r over common(u, v) = R(u) & R(v) in bevId order: sum((x - mean x)(y - mean y)) / sqrt(sum((x - mean x)^2) * sum((y - mean y)^2)), clamped to [-1, 1]; 0 when |common| < cfMinCommon or either side is constant (all entries equal); sim = r * min(1, |common| / cfSignificance)
constants.tasteAttributeKey: 'category:' + categoryId, 'brand:' + normaliseBrand(brand) when non-empty, 'flavor:' + trim(flavorBase) when non-empty; kept when it covers >= tasteMinAttrBevs catalog Bevs
constants.tasteVectorRule: t_u[a] = sum of z_{u,b} over b in R(u) carrying a / (n_{u,a} + tasteK); Bevs outside the catalog skipped
constants.attributeSimilarityRule: cosine of the taste vectors as sparse vectors (missing = 0), clamped to [-1, 1]; 0 when either is all zeros
constants.sharedAttrsRule: count of attributes a of a tasteBridgeKinds kind with |t_u[a]| >= tasteSharedMin and |t_v[a]| >= tasteSharedMin that u and v reach through distinct Bevs: some b in R(u) and b2 in R(v) carry a with b != b2 (one co-rated Bev is not a bridge)
constants.blendRule: alpha = tasteAlpha if |common| >= cfMinCommon else 0; attributeSim = attributeSimilarity if |common| >= cfMinCommon or sharedAttrs >= tasteMinSharedAttrs else 0; sim = alpha * pearson.sim + (1 - alpha) * attributeSim, clamped to [-1, 1]; method = attr (alpha 0), pearson (alpha 1), else blend
constants.neighbourOrder: sim desc, then userId asc (code point, SQL collate "C"); keep sim >= tasteSimFloor; at most tasteNeighbourK
constants.reliabilityRule: min(1, n_v / neighbourReliabilityN); applied by Layer 2 per neighbour, not stored in user_neighbors.sim
constants.bayesStoredRule: bev_stats.bayes_score numeric(4,2) from exact inputs: m with at most 3 dp (global_stats.mean_score numeric(5,3), or the exact category mean), scores in cents; N = C*m_thousandths + 10*sum(score_cents), D = C + n; storedCents = round half away from zero of N / (10*D) = floor((2N + 10D) / (20D)); never round the floating-point bayes
constants.streakEvents: streakFromTimestamps.timestamps are ranking EVENTS (submit_ranking and rerank_bev), never deleted: a re-rank adds its own day and keeps the original one; a removal adds and deletes nothing. When a case lists input.events, timestamps = events.map(at)
constants.layer1EdgesRule: bevSimilarity 'edges': sim(b, b') = w of the snapshot.edges row for the unordered pair {b, b'} (either orientation), 0 when there is none; pairs with sim < simMin dropped as in 'content'; content = sum(sim * z) / (sum(sim) + 1); conf1 mass = n_{u,cat(b)} + sum(sim); affinity and g unchanged. A snapshot without an edges field (absent or null) uses contentSimilarity ('content'); an empty array means no edges
